counting_unit: Same policy + every condition field except opponent_id + same candidate camp.

definition_question.live_or_arbitrarily_reordered_menu_equiv: Not established and generally false. The official interface does not guarantee this simulator's menu order.
definition_question.reason: idle chooses an offered idle wherever it occurs; first_legal chooses the first usable offer. A menu ordered [macro_advance, button_0] separates their actions without any game execution.
definition_question.source_argument: DiagnosticGame._entries always starts each eligible hero menu with a complete button_0, including dead heroes. view preserves that order; _offers preserves per-seat order; both controllers share the same scheduler. Thus idle and first_legal choose the same button_0 action for the same scheduled hero.
definition_question.tag_difference: ResearchBot.decide includes self.name in the tag, so the labels differ. _policy_call discards _tag; the tag is not game action data or hashed state.

limits: Two final world seeds, correlated profiles/modes/camps/shared code, zero real-game evidence.
Raw per-call traces and detailed timing are absent from the permitted public index; their equality is unverified.
Distinct trajectory hashes do not establish independent gameplay, because config and seed are included in the digest.
This audit does not relabel or remove records from the original 400; it explains control redundancy.
recommended_description: Each strategy won all 120 listed weak-control legs, but these contain 40 idle/first_legal duplicate-control leg pairs. Under this simulator menu there are two distinct weak-control action rules, explicit idle and uniform current macros-plus-idle, not three. Retaining one idle-equivalent arm leaves 80 listed legs per strategy; those legs remain correlated and are not independent real games.
scope: Only public paired index and source archive were read; no rescoring, games, source edits or unsafe extraction.

trajectory_question.hash_construction: SHA256 initialized with initial state_hash string, then updated once per outer play_game iteration after tick/terminal handling with the new state_hash string.
trajectory_question.scope_warning: Equal recorded hashes are evidence of equal covered snapshot trajectories, not a separate proof of byte-identical per-call traces. Action equivalence here is additionally inferred from the archived menu and controller source.
trajectory_question.state_hash_serialization: SHA256 of JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=False.
